🚀 TAWG Daily Catch-up — 2026-08-22 23:00 UTC → 2026-08-23 23:00 UTC

What moved

- Jimmy confirmed no objection on Q2 (inline digest with full set by reference) and Q4 (Profile D as explicit condition-carrying opt-in), clearing both for v0.2 [tg:tawg:3154]
- Tiago independently recomputed b9fc7e6 from a clean clone — full suite passing, divergence vectors green both ways, mutation gate 5/5 killed with zero survivors, confirming the amendment is load-bearing [tg:tawg:3156]
- agent-sdk PR #20 merged: Go clients for erc8263 and erc8281 now wait for transaction mining before returning, closing the latent race condition class [https://github.com/trustless-ai/agent-sdk/commit/6421dad4afa732d8187a15e3300454b8f0e6ec25]
- agent-sdk PR #21 reached merge-ready after Jimmy's verified Rust path fix (include_str! for shared vectors) and Zidan applied the suggestion [https://github.com/trustless-ai/agent-sdk/pull/21#issuecomment-5387846660]
- Org-wide contributing convention merged: every spec and reference impl must ship a limits section written before the artifact exists [https://github.com/trustless-ai/.github/commit/63fcf1911eeb129e71919a3f629e8fc08dc56b9d]
- ERC-8301 interface gained the missing AgentReplyAnchored event, and the README payload docs were corrected to match encodeProof [https://github.com/trustless-ai/agent-ercs/commit/971aaebb3679c318986b8758166d1e97e5ea083d]
- Damon shared the v0.2 cut with all Q1-Q4 resolved and §13 ratification record circulated for position checks [tg:tawg:3165]
- Fede and Pavlo both confirmed their §13 positions are accurately recorded [tg:tawg:3168]
- Fede shipped an operation-id field on /review's Bearer-auth path, fixing a real replay and double-billing gap discovered in production [tg:tawg:3162]

Ideas worth carrying forward

- The UNVERIFIABLE enum should be append-only: members name the verification step that could not complete, unrecognized members lose the branch but preserve the verdict, and meaning is never repurposed [tg:tawg:3161]
- Pavlo formalized the compatibility boundary — same member means same procedure semantics; changed semantics requires a new member; deprecation removes from production but never rewrites history [tg:tawg:3164]
- Fede's corollary: §13 itself is a provenance surface and should follow the same append-only discipline — superseded resolutions get new rows, never edits [tg:tawg:3167]
- The limits-section test from the new contributing convention: could this boundary have been written before the work existed? If not, it describes outcome rather than bounding claims [https://github.com/trustless-ai/.github/pull/5]

Open threads / help wanted

- Pavlo flagged that §13 uses "LANDED" for ccip-router #3/#4 but Tiago confirmed those are still on branches with main at base — wording should say implemented/verified, pending merge [tg:tawg:3168]
- Fede's /review use-case pass is queued for next session — no tight clock unless envelope schema or reference Profile A need it sooner [tg:tawg:3167]
- Next steps from §13: envelope schema, reference Profile A implementation, the doc's own spec-mutations.json, and formally connecting Pavlo so TSEI can cite Profile A as its resolution layer [tg:tawg:3166]

Appreciation

- Damon for maintaining consolidated state and getting the v0.2 cut out with every position accurately tracked [tg:tawg:3157]
- Zidan for persisting through all review rounds on PR #20 and turning PR #21 around cleanly [tg:tawg:3158]
- Baby Blue Viper for local testing on PR #21 and for the real-world operation-id fix that validates the theoretical nonce split [https://github.com/trustless-ai/agent-sdk/pull/21#issuecomment-5388339931]
- Tiago for the weekend recompute that closes the eligibility loop with full independent verification [tg:tawg:3156]

Next step

Review Pavlo's two precision points on §13 wording (branch status vs landed, append-only ratification rows) and decide whether to adjust before the cut is finalized. If you have a view on merge sequencing for #3 then #4, now is the moment to speak up.
